subject: Showing exogenous manifest variable in plot drawed with semPaths()

messages.author: ec12e510d7b112ad
messages.subject: Showing exogenous manifest variable in plot drawed with semPaths()
parts:
Hi all, 

this might be not the right place to ask. But since there is no specific user group to the semPlot package I´ll give it a try. 

I have one exogenous manifest variable in my model consisting of several latent variables. I would like to show this manifest variable in a path diagram together with the structural part of the latent model as this makes a lot of sense to me. But if I choose structural = F all my indicators are shown too which makes the path diagram rather difficult to read. 

How can I show only this manifest exogenous variable without showing all the others?

Are there better alternatives to plot path diagrams based on lavaan objects?

Thanks
